title: NASA Finds Evidence of Ancient Ice Beyond Neptune! 🧊
body: NASA Finds Evidence of Ancient Ice Beyond Neptune! 🧊
NASA scientists have found the strongest evidence yet of an ancient ice reservoir in the Kuiper Belt — a ring of icy objects located beyond the planet Neptune at the edge of our Solar System.

The evidence came from 12 tiny dust grains collected from the stratosphere, the upper layer of the atmosphere, by a research aircraft. In them, they found minerals that formed when water reacted with dust at the dawn of Solar System history, and water carrying a "fingerprint" of heavy oxygen isotopes.
An isotope is a heavier version of the same atom, and it works like a fingerprint that reveals the origin of matter. This discovery helps explain how the planets formed.
